decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana production using various elf creatures and Gaea's Cradle, allowing for explosive plays and early creature deployment. The deck also utilizes the powerful card Survival of the Fittest to tutor for key creatures and maintain board presence. The inclusion of creatures like Deranged Hermit and Masticore provides strong offensive threats, while cards like Wirewood Symbiote and Quirion Ranger offer versatility and protection. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and aggressive Elf tribal strategy.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly by deploying a large number of low-cost creatures, particularly elves, to generate mana and accelerate the game. The key strategy revolves around using cards like Fyndhorn Elves, Priest of Titania, and Gaea's Cradle to ramp up mana production, while also utilizing creatures like Quirion Ranger and Wirewood Symbiote to maximize efficiency and ensure a steady stream of creatures on the battlefield. Survival of the Fittest is used to tutor for specific creatures and maintain board presence, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of creatures and powerful finishers like Phantom Nantuko and Deranged Hermit.

This deck focuses on quickly building a wide board of Elf creatures, utilizing mana acceleration from cards like Fyndhorn Elves and Llanowar Elves to power out powerful threats like Priest of Titania and Wirewood Symbiote. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a constant stream of aggressive elves while gaining life through Wellwisher and drawing cards with Sylvan Messenger. Additional support from cards like Sylvan Library and Gaea's Cradle help to maintain card advantage and ramp up mana production, allowing for explosive plays and overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of elves.

The deck revolves around quickly assembling Phyrexian Dreadnought along with Stifle to create a powerful and difficult to deal with threat. The Stiflenought combo is supported by a mix of control elements such as Counterspell, Duress, and removal spells like Smother and Chain of Vapor. Card draw and selection spells like Accumulated Knowledge, Impulse, and Portent help to find the combo pieces quickly. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win condition in a fast and efficient manner.

The primary focus of this deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan using a variety of counter spells and disruptive cards like Force Spike and Stifle. The deck also includes card draw spells like Fact or Fiction and Accumulated Knowledge to maintain card advantage. Additionally, the deck includes land disruption tools such as Dust Bowl and Quicksand to further disrupt the opponent's mana base. The win condition of the deck is to slowly chip away at the opponent's life total using man lands like Mishra's Factory and Faerie Conclave.

The main concept of this deck is to control the board and outvalue the opponent using the Oath of Druids combo. By disrupting the opponent's resources with cards like Sphere of Resistance and Wasteland, while also ramping up mana with Mox Diamond, the deck aims to quickly bring out powerful threats like Terravore. The deck also includes removal spells like Naturalize and board wipes like Pyroclasm to clear the way for its creatures to dominate the battlefield. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent while maintaining card advantage with cards like Sylvan Library.

The main idea of this deck is to lock down your opponent by utilizing the Stasis enchantment to prevent them from untapping their permanents. By combining this with cards like Black Vise to deal damage when they have too many cards in hand, as well as countermagic to protect your combo, you can control the game and eventually win through alternative win conditions like Brain Freeze or Upheaval. The deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's strategy and outlasting them until you can achieve victory.

The deck focuses on playing low-cost creatures with the Madness ability to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. The key strategy is to discard cards with high mana value to trigger additional benefits from cards like Circular Logic and Frantic Search. Survival of the Fittest is used to search for key creatures and maintain card advantage. The deck also includes counterspells like Daze and Mana Leak to protect its threats. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient aggressive strategy.

This deck focuses on building a strong aggressive board presence with efficient creatures like Carnophage and Dauthi Slayer, backed up by disruption spells like Duress and removal like Diabolic Edict. The key strategy is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with early threats while disrupting their game plan with discard spells. The inclusion of Rancor provides additional aggression and resilience to removal spells. The mana base is optimized to support the aggressive game plan while also ensuring consistent access to all colors needed for spells.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble a combo using cards like Test of Endurance and Worthy Cause to win the game. The deck includes various cards that allow for tutoring and searching for specific pieces of the combo, as well as protection with cards like Seal of Cleansing and Swords to Plowshares. The creatures in the deck, including Task Force, Nomads en-Kor, Daru Spiritualist, and Shaman en-Kor, are used to help achieve the combo and ensure its success. The land base is carefully crafted to support the overall strategy of the deck.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to outvalue the opponent. The deck aims to stall the game using land-based control cards like Mishra's Factory and Dust Bowl while generating card advantage through spells like Accumulated Knowledge and Fact or Fiction. The win condition is to either control the board with creatures like Exalted Angel or create an overwhelming board presence with spells like Decree of Justice. The deck aims to grind out the opponent and win the game through attrition.

This deck focuses on quick and aggressive creature plays combined with burn spells to deal damage fast and efficiently. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a constant stream of threats while also being able to finish them off with direct damage from spells like Lightning Bolt and Fireblast. The use of cards like Sulfuric Vortex and Cursed Scroll adds additional pressure and chip damage that can help secure victory in the early turns of the game.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively deal direct damage to the opponent using cards like Ball Lightning, Grim Lavamancer, and Lightning Bolt. The strategy involves quickly overwhelming the opponent with small creatures and burn spells, while also maintaining pressure with cards like Sulfuric Vortex. This deck aims to end the game quickly and decisively by keeping up a steady stream of damage and preventing the opponent from stabilizing. It focuses on maintaining a strong board presence and controlling the tempo of the game through aggressive plays.

This deck focuses on creating a lock-down effect using Stasis to prevent opponents from untapping their permanents. By combining Stasis with cards like Black Vise and Ivory Tower to apply pressure and gain card advantage, the deck aims to control the game and win through a combo finish. The deck also includes card draw and counter spells for added consistency and protection. With a strong resource denial strategy, this deck aims to disrupt opponents' plans and secure victory through a well-executed combo.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly play Phyrexian Dreadnought and counter any potential removal spells or abilities using Stifle, Counterspell, Foil, and other counterspells. The deck aims to stop any threats from opponents while setting up the Dreadnought combo to deal a large amount of damage in a short amount of time. The deck also includes card draw and manipulation spells to help find the combo pieces quickly and efficiently. The goal is to efficiently control the game until the combo is assembled and win the game in a single attack.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by using cards that allow for graveyard recursion, hand disruption, and tutor abilities to find key creatures and spells. The deck aims to survive early game aggression with walls and mana dorks, while setting up its key combo pieces such as Survival of the Fittest and Natural Order to cheat out powerful creatures like Verdant Force and Multani, Maro-Sorcerer. The deck is designed to outvalue and outlast opponents by maintaining card advantage and superior board presence.
